+"""Record preparation steps reusing pytest diagnostic escaping."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import ascii_escaped
+
+
+def display(value: bytes | str) -> str:
+    """Escape ``value`` using pytest ASCII-escaped diagnostic semantics."""
+    if not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
+        raise ValueError("value must be str or bytes")
+    return ascii_escaped(value)
+
+
+def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return a new prepared dict.
+
+    The result has exactly ``key`` (trimmed), ``value`` (unchanged),
+    ``display`` (escaped value) and ``enabled``.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record requires a value entry")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("enabled must be a bool")
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key.strip(),
+        "value": value,
+        "display": display(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

@@ -37,3 +37,19 @@ def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
         "display": display(value),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

@@ -53,3 +53,12 @@ def batch(records: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
         seen.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: Any) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Group enabled display values by the first character of their key."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

+def merge(left: Any, right: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Merge prepared records; right replaces left by key, new keys append."""
